name: ozon-api-doc
description: Ozon 官方 API (Seller & Performance) OpenAPI 规范镜像与交互式文档站

scripts.build:specs: node node_modules/@redocly/cli/bin/cli.js build-docs specs/ozon-seller-openapi.json --output docs/public/standalone-seller.html && node node_modules/@redocly/cli/bin/cli.js build-docs specs/ozon-performance-openapi.json --output docs/public/standalone-performance.html
scripts.docs:dev: npm run build:specs && vitepress dev docs
scripts.docs:build: npm run build:specs && vitepress build docs
